workflow_steps.title: Reproject borough boundaries to DEM CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Make the borough polygons spatially compatible with the DEM for zonal statistics.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the input borough boundary vector from its known source CRS to EPSG:3857, preserving the borough features and attributes.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute the average DEM elevation within the State College and Bellefonte borough boundaries.
workflow_steps.instructions: Calculate mean elevation values from the DEM raster for each polygon in the reprojected borough boundary layer. Preserve or emit a zone identifier sufficient to distinguish the borough results; runtime QC must ground any required identifier fields from the observed schema.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Raster Analysis Agent
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic raster reprojection, resampling, clipping, raster calculation, and zonal statistics. Consumes GeoTIFF rasters and GeoPackage polygon zones.

skills.name: Raster Geoprocessing
skills.description: Executes raster calculations, reprojections, grid resampling, spatial masking, and zonal aggregations.

constraints.spatial: Raster calculation requires compatible grid definitions and CRS. Zonal statistics require matching CRS between raster and GeoPackage zones.
other: Accepts GeoTIFF (.tif) rasters and GeoPackage (.gpkg) polygon zones.
Does not accept GeoJSON zones for zonal statistics.
